title: Autumn Forest
description: Adds an autumn themed forest with oak and birch trees
body:
![Autumn Forest V1.1.1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9dffdbfaac1ac3f0718f9f473191037ffda1994.png)
![Current Look of the Autumn Biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/276881657b16511aea3d585f5a3b80ab90ef555c_0.webp)

This is a **mod** that adds a new biome called the autumn forest. It is a vanilla friendly mod and doesn't add new content except the autumn forest biome. It is a varient of the birch forest with new features which includes:
- Autumn orange grass and leaf tint
- Oak and birch bushes
- Birch, oak and fancy trees
- Extra pumpkin patches
- A hay camp structure
- Autumn themed flowers

_* As of version 1.1.1_

And other features that generate exclusive to the autumn forest.
